messages:
maria_cs: Hey team — prepping an evidence package for VegaHealth's renewal. They want uptime details + p95 latency acceptance. Customer specified 90-day rolling windows. Can Eng/SRE confirm data sources and any config changes to call out? @tim_eng @nate_sre :wave:

tim_eng: We can pull uptime from Grafana/prometheus and traces for p95. Will paste the exact queries shortly. Do we need raw logs too or aggregated CSVs?

nate_sre: 90-day rolling is what they asked. I can generate an export of uptime windows and incident summaries. CSV ok?

maria_cs: CSV + short human-readable summary per incident please — include start/end, root cause, mitigation. Also need a short note about onboarding gaps we observed (e.g., missing health-check hooks).

tim_eng: For p95 latency use this prom query: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))` — matches dashboard. For traces, query by span `model_inference` filtered by customer route.

jenna_ops: Runbook items to include: fallback model variant, cache-warmup policy, traffic-shaping thresholds. I'll extract the current canary history (dates + results).

maria_cs: Awesome. Also FYI Vega flagged a perceived perf regression after our quantization rollout last fall — if that's relevant note timeline + rollback options.

tim_eng: Good call — quantization deploy on 2025-11-08 did change tail latency a bit. We'll annotate as config change and include mitigation (pin to non-quantized variant).

nate_sre: I'm running the report now: `python tools/sla_report.py --customer vegahealth --window 90 --format csv` — will drop to S3 when done.

ops-bot: runbook-notify: new runbook draft created at https://redwood.internal/runbooks/vegahealth-ops (permissions: customer-success, eng, sre)

maria_cs: For credits calc — remind me the formula we use? Is it prorated minutes down vs total minutes in the 90-day window (per contract)?

jenna_ops: Yes, standard: credit = max(0, (SLO - observed)/SLO) * monthly_fee, then prorated per contract terms. I'll include an example calc with numbers so CS can show.

tim_eng: I'll also add a short technical appendix showing queries and the dashboard screenshots. Which time range should screenshots use? Last 30 / 90?

maria_cs: Screenshots: 90-day graph + a zoomed 7-day around each incident. Helps narrative.

nate_sre: Upload complete — s3://redwood-cs-evidence/vegahealth/2645012345/ (uptime.csv, incidents.csv, latency_prom_query.txt). Sharing link to CSV now.

maria_cs: Received. I'll assemble slides and a one-page evidence bundle (pdf) for the renewal packet. Planning a handoff call with Vega on Thursday 11am PT — need Eng + SRE on the call. @tim_eng @nate_sre can you join?

tim_eng: Yep, I'll be there and prepare the appendix.

nate_sre: Count me in. I'll have the CSV and quick CLI summary.

jenna_ops: I'll prep the runbook excerpt and a 3-step ops checklist to include in the packet.

maria_cs: Perfect. After the call we'll upload the final evidence bundle to the contract folder and clear the renewal-risk flag if all good. Thanks team! :tada:
